events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th St and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand pop-up celebrating the new Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with product discovery, refreshments, giveaways and a photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ samples, refreshments and croissants while supplies last; scratch-off prizes are also advertised, and the first 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: Bobbi Brown's organizer listing invites the public to the one-day experience and advertises free giveaways. Complimentary items and prizes are while supplies last. Photo/video content will be captured at the event for Bobbi Brown social/digital use.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 12 PM–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle. Arrive early if the deluxe sample is the priority because only the first 100 guests in line receive it.

events.what_it_is: TEMPTATIONS' first Cat Bodega, a free immersive pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats with a cat-inspired bodega environment, games and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples; games including a claw machine and scratch-offs offer chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: The brand explicitly describes the physical NYC pop-up as free. Treats and merchandise prizes are promotional inventory and may be limited; no advance RSVP requirement is published by the brand.
events.practical_notes: Open Thursday–Saturday, September 17–19, 12 PM–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. Each date is represented as a separate occurrence below.

events.event_name: CookUnity The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N’ Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A three-hour CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis where eight chefs serve complimentary CookUnity dishes, with hot bites, cold packaged meals and bodega-style scratch-off prizes.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made dishes while supplies last; guests also receive a scratch-off for chances to win CookUnity meals for a year or participating-chef dining experiences.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources describe the event as open to the public and free, with food while supplies last. No RSVP or ticket requirement is published in the verified sources. Because this is a high-demand three-hour giveaway, inventory can run out before the stated end time.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five Manhattan bodegas: Flatiron, Chelsea, Midtown, West Village and Murray Hill. Arriving before 11:30 AM is prudent if receiving a meal is the priority.
